_notes: This model is the easy case DISC-019 describes: its materials are called Window, Callipers
and LightA, so the nominal cue labels most of it without help and syndicate-prepare clears
the D15-R13 gate on its own at 68.6%.
Four names take it to about 90%. Every one is a paint or trim material whose token — Coloured,
Carbon, Base, Textured — says what it is *finished in* rather than what it *is*, which is
precisely the distinction no vocabulary can be made to cover and what D15-R9 exists for.
